issue_context.title: Vite V6 can't resolve alias if css transformer is lightningcss
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

### I am doing:
I am using Vite v6.0.1 in my project with the lightningcss CSS transformer enabled. My configuration includes custom aliases in vite.config.ts, such as `@assets` pointing to the assets folder. In my CSS files, I reference assets using this alias, like this:

`background-image: url("@assets/vue.svg");`

### What I expect is:
The alias `@assets` should resolve to the correct path. 

### What actually happens is:
When the lightningcss transformer is enabled, Vite fails to resolve the alias `@assets` in CSS files and Vue style files.

### Reproduction

https://stackblitz.com/edit/vitejs-vite-c1vaah?file=src%2Fstyle.css

### Steps to reproduce

Run `npm run dev`

### System Info

```shell
Windows
```


### Used Package Manager

npm

### Logs

[plugin:vite:css-analysis] ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '@assets/vue.svg'
/home/projects/vitejs-vite-c1vaah/src/style.css

review_comments:
This line added non-resolved URLs to `deps`. But `deps` should only include file paths.

That URL was passed to `fileToDevUrl` here.
https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/51a5569e66bd7f0de79ac14b9e902d1382ccd0aa/packages/vite/src/node/plugins/css.ts#L1056-L1060
Then, this `fs.readFile` was called for svg files.
https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/51a5569e66bd7f0de79ac14b9e902d1382ccd0aa/packages/vite/src/node/plugins/asset.ts#L287
For the postcss transformer, we didn't add `url()` referenced assets to `deps`.
https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/51a5569e66bd7f0de79ac14b9e902d1382ccd0aa/packages/vite/src/node/plugins/css.ts#L1370-L1374
So for now, I think we can simply remove this `deps.add`. In future, maybe we should add `url()` referenced files to `deps` as well.
